items.title: Veteran Benefits Kit — the front door
items.use: Start here. Picks the right page for the question: planning a term, finding your benefit, or working the desk.

items.title: Semester Pay Planner
items.use: Enter sessions, classes and credits; see the monthly housing or subsistence figure per stretch of the term, with the VA rule behind it one tap away.

items.title: Which Benefit Am I On
items.use: How to find the benefit you already have; the programs side by side; who to ask. Compares, does not decide.

items.title: Benefits Front-Desk Map
items.use: For whoever is at the desk: fourteen situations, one check each, the branch, the hand-over, the source. Office sheet, not the student handout.

restrictedScan.note: The package encodes and lists only these four addresses; the student sheet carries only the three student-facing ones. No repository path, brief, transcript, harness, ADR or Drive address appears anywhere in the package.
